params.body:
Replaces #150 (the hand cannot update an existing branch; one test used a field whose rule checks string length instead of a number).

The sheet already works on a draft row (photos, damage and options post to it), but the wired fields only reached it on 'Opslaan', so two blue buttons competed and walking away lost the typed data.

**Create mode**
- 'Volgende' calls saveStep(step): validates only the format rules of that step (required waits for the end) and writes the wired scalars to the draft (dates parsed, weights as numbers, empty strings as null, non-columns skipped). A quiet 'Bewaard 10:42' appears next to the buttons.
- The last step has the one real button, 'Wagen toevoegen' = save(): full validation, names the fields still missing, marks is_complete.
- The unsaved-changes guard resets after a step save.

**Edit mode** is unchanged: explicit 'Opslaan' on every step, 'Volgende' is plain navigation. A published vehicle must not change while someone is still typing a price.

Tests: step save keeps is_complete 0 and skips required; a format error on the step blocks next; edit mode never saves on next.
params.title: Adding a vehicle: save on next, finish on the last step
